gholam.text: رفقا، علی کاشانی یه ماجرای جالب از اواخر سال ۲۰۲۳ تعریف کرده درباره اینکه چطور جنسن هوانگ، مدیرعامل انویدیا، در بحرانی‌ترین شرایط به داد شرکتش رسید. کاشانی می‌گه بعد از اینکه سرمایه‌گذارشون دقیقه نود کنار کشید، حتی پول پرداخت حقوق بچه‌ها رو نداشتن و کار عملاً به مشورت با وکلای ورشکستگی کشیده بود. همون موقع به جنسن هوانگ ایمیل می‌زنه و جنسن هم ساعت ۶ صبح بهش زنگ می‌زنه و همون شب تیمش رو می‌فرسته تا با تأمین مالی موقت، شرکت رو از بحران خارج کنن. به گفته خودش، با همین کمک سرپا موندن و درست چهار ماه بعدش موفق شدن زنگ عرضه عمومی سهام شرکت رو در بورس نزدک به صدا دربیارن.

links.text:
Days before Christmas 2023, I emailed Jensen after an investor pulled out last minute. We didn’t have cash for payroll, and I was talking with bankruptcy lawyers.

Jensen called me at 6am. Later that day, I was having dinner with his team to bridge the company. Four months later, we rang the NASDAQ bell for our IPO.

quote.text:
In June @NaderLikeLadder emailed Jensen about a crazy idea we had over dinner to make Local AI 10x better on NVIDIA hardware.

Jensen replied in 7 minutes. He saw this as important work, and approved a war room for us to work on this at NVIDIA HQ.

For a month, NVIDIA HQ was the @exolabs satellite office. We were overwhelmed by the support we got. We were back to back the first week with smart NVIDIANs coming in to our war room to help us. Creators of CUDA, Dynamo, people who built NVIDIA.
 
Long story short with NVIDIA we managed to improve their Local AI playbooks by 9.6x (almost the 10x goal we set out with). We’ll be publishing a whitepaper on this work.

We were just a small startup with a crazy idea. Jensen took a bet on us. Jensen cares deeply about Open Source AI and Local AI.

I don't believe Jensen is replaceable, he's a 1 of 1 human, but I hope NVIDIA will continue to aggressively support Open Source AI and Local AI, and continue to take bets on small startups with crazy ideas.

Thank you Jensen
